_spec: What the emitter must write for engine/audit.js to run every rule. This file is the CONTRACT, not an example: a field named here is a field a rule reads. Rules whose fields are absent report needs-data, never pass.

_files.emit/manifest.json: One record per asset. Per-asset facts: what it is, how it plays, what it contains.
_files.emit/plates.json: One record per emitted PLATE (asset × hour × aspect). Per-plate facts: geometry, fills, boxes.

manifest.json.C: number — the anchor constant. Rule 8 compares it against the value derived from design-tokens.json and fails on disagreement. Emit it so the two can be checked against each other; never as the source.

<asset id>.role: 'host' | 'room' | 'plate' | 'overlay' — rule 7 fails any host-role asset with no hostAnchor
<asset id>.dir: string — the folder, carried from the rename map
<asset id>.hostAnchor: [x, y, w, h] or null — required when role is 'host'
<asset id>.gradients: number — rule 1 fails on any non-zero
<asset id>.partialOpacity: number — rule 2 fails on any non-zero; count of nodes whose opacity is neither 0 nor 1
<asset id>.textNodes: number — rule 10 fails on any non-zero; all type is outlined

plates.json.figureInkAspect: number — the figure's ink width divided by the 720-unit box height. Rule 16 checks every anchor width equals height × this. An anchor publishes a HEIGHT; the width is derived (§4.4a).

plates.hour: 'night' | 'dusk' — rule 3 resolves fills against this hour's palette
plates.twinId: string — the id shared by an asset's two hours. Rule 6 requires both twins to carry the same geometryHash.
plates.geometryHash: string — hash of the shape list ONLY, no colours. Rule 6.
plates.fills: [hex, …] — every fill actually emitted. Rule 3 fails any not in the hour's declared palette.
plates.strokes: [{colour, width}, …] — rule 4 requires exactly one distinct pair per hour
plates.shapeCount: number — rule 11 requires ≥ 6 on room plates (§4.3)
plates.box: [x, y, w, h] — the PUBLISHED figure box. Every pose publishes the standing box, padded above (§2.5).
plates.inkBox: [x0, y0, x1, y1] — the plate's real ink extent. Rule 13 fails if it leaves box.
plates.hostAnchor: [x, y, w, h] — room plates only
plates.portraitWindow: [x, y, w, h] — room plates only. Rule 14 requires hostAnchor inside it (§4.4a).
plates.occlusionSplit: number — the index from which shapes paint AFTER the host: the first shape whose explicit layer is front. Rule 15 requires it on every anchored room; a room with no anchor declares none (§4.5).
plates.clearance: { poses, head: {pose, headCover}, upper: {pose, upperCover}, figureBox } — anchored rooms only. The composite measured by kit-model.js clearanceOf over every pose that fits. Rule 27: headCover 0, upperCover <= 10 (§4.5).
plates.title: { slot, ground } in room units — opener rooms only. Rule 28: slot inside ground, ground inside portraitWindow and clear of clearance.figureBox (§5.3).

_notes: Rules 5, 8, 12, 17 and 18 read design-tokens.json alone and run today — they were verified against the real tokens at rebuild-06 and agree to the digit with the review surface.
Every other rule reports needs-data until the emitter writes these two files. needs-data is a schedule; DID NOT RUN is a defect. --check exits non-zero on the second, not the first (§8).

engine/audit.legacy.js is the predecessor's boil metric, kept because it settled a real disagreement about over-boiled assets. It measures stroke motion, and §6 removes the strokes it measured — it becomes live again only if annotations/ are rebuilt with strokes.
